messages:
nina (design): Quick user session note: on small phones the 'Model runs' list causes horizontal scroll and the collapsed sidebar overlaps the action buttons. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/example :frowning:

tom (frontend): I can repro at 360x640. Actions column has a min-width so it forces the whole table wider.

vicky (product): this blocks triage on mobile users — they can't open run details reliably.

leo (mobile): options: 1) move secondary actions into a kebab menu at <=400px, 2) make sidebar an overlay (not push) so it doesn't cover action area. Overlay should be swipe-to-close.

nina (design): prefer overlay + stacked row layout under 420px. Stacked rows keep primary ID left and actions below as a line, kebab for extras. I'll make mocks for 320/375/414.

tom (frontend): stacking OK. Need to keep virtualization (we use react-window). We can keep single row DOM and toggle display; if heights vary we'll use VariableSizeList. I'll prototype with ff_mobile_table_layout flag.

maya (qa): QA notes: check landscape on small devices, ensure overlay doesn't add a second scroll, verify touch target sizes for kebab (>=44px).

aria-a11y-bot: a11y reminders: overlay must have role="dialog" and aria-modal="true", trap focus, restore focus to trigger, and announce state change. Kebab should have accessible name "More actions" and be reachable in reading order when rows stack.

vicky (product): small copy change: kebab aria-label = "More actions for run"; drawer header = short run id on first line, full model name truncated on second line with long-press to show full. Improves scannability.

tom (frontend): Plan: add CSS @media (max-width:420px) to switch rows to column layout, show kebab, overlay for sidebar, and provide a CSS hook to allow server-driven column rules. PR scheduled Wed, QA Thu.

nina (design): Uploaded figma variants: https://figma.com/file/example/mobile-stacked-variants. Acceptance criteria: no horizontal scroll at 320/375/412, kebab 44px min, overlay focus trap, truncated names show on long-press. :thumbsup:
